name: Upstox Read-Only Market Data APIs v3
lawful_access_basis: Private authenticated research use through an operator-authorized Upstox account and free read-only Analytics Token; no display or redistribution outside the private research system.
fields: NSE equity daily, weekly, monthly, hourly, and minute OHLCV with timestamps
current NSE equity and F&O instrument identifiers, expiry, strike, option type, tick size, and lot size
current option best bid, best ask, bid and ask quantities, traded volume, and open interest
feed receipt timestamp, last trade timestamp, underlying price, and available option greeks
latency: Historical REST plus request-time and streaming market data; original provider and local receipt timestamps retained.
collection_method: Authenticated read-only Upstox V3 REST and WebSocket market-data endpoints only; order, portfolio, funds, and account-mutation endpoints are prohibited.
retention_policy: Store immutable raw responses and hashes for seven years in private access-controlled storage solely for internal paper research; no external display or redistribution.
